name: Dimitrios Papakonstantinou
bio:
Dimitrios's journey in motorsport began not in the grandstands, but in his uncle's workshop, tinkering with engines from a young age. He quickly developed a knack for understanding the intricacies of mechanical systems. After earning his engineering degree, he joined a small regional racing team, honing his skills in data analysis and vehicle dynamics. His methodical approach and ability to quickly diagnose problems earned him a reputation as a reliable and resourceful engineer.

He moved to Boutsen VDS after a successful stint with a Formula 3 team, seeking new challenges and a higher level of competition. Dimitrios believes in fostering open communication within the team, encouraging drivers to provide honest feedback about the car's performance. He's known for his meticulous data analysis and his ability to translate complex technical information into actionable strategies, making him a valuable asset on the pit wall. What sets him apart is his calm demeanor under pressure, a trait highly valued during tense race situations. He is also very fond of greek yoghurt.

physical.description: Dimitrios has a sturdy build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small worry stone in his pocket
Insists on having a specific type of Greek coffee before each race
Tends to over-explain technical concepts using analogies
